build_tfds_dataset: build a tensorflow dataset by downloading and preparing it with tfds build command
build_tfds_download_only: build a tensorflow dataset by downloading files only without preparing with --download_only flag
build_tfds_parallel: build multiple tensorflow datasets in parallel using --num_processes flag
build_tfds_custom_config: build a tensorflow dataset with a specific config using --config or --config_idx flag
build_tfds_publish: build a tensorflow dataset and publish the generated data to a specified directory with --publish_dir flag
